approval_source: The decision owner approved the recommended continuation and directed the approved Godot plans to be implemented without pausing. This receipt records that authorization only for the M04 Red Umbrella player-authored manual slice, after confirming that prior M01 and M04 receipts did not include this exact protected data and shared presentation scope.
scope_summary: Implement M04's existing three-clue manual and its existing rule/rescue context through the existing draft-only workbench. Use text-only Archivist Aka for M04; preserve Lume portrait and M01 semantics as CASE-01-only. Do not create new clues, rules, save fields, semantic answer evaluation, release claims, M05+ content, or asset promotion.
